details: No evidence of supply-chain attack behavior was identified in this package version. There are no indicators of credential exfiltration, install-time remote code execution, silent relays to attacker-controlled destinations, droppers, backdoors, or namespace-abuse patterns. No lifecycle script harms, no hardcoded attacker endpoints, and no obfuscated payloads were observed in the package contents.
